name: labs/croningp__pycont
title: Tricontinent C3000 syringe pump (pycont.C3000Controller)
intro: Tricontinent C3000 syringe pump (pycont.C3000Controller), adapted from croningp/pycont. It reads `volume`, `plunger_position`, `top_velocity`, `default_top_velocity` and 2 more; sets `valve_position`; runs `run_pump` and `terminate`. `run_pump`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/croningp__pycont --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/croningp__pycont --backend fake --mcp
